The default on-device modes do not use Cloud billing. This screen shows historical usage for the optional legacy integration only; importing a credential does not switch the active runtime.

Optional advanced migration storage. Mini Conversation does not need this credential for its default modes and never selects legacy Cloud automatically. Imported credentials are validated, encrypted on this device, excluded from backup, and can be deleted here.
Your name will be displayed by all nearby devices, while your profile picture will only be shown on devices with which you have already had conversations

The Conversation mode is the main feature of Mini Conversation, it allows you to translate a conversation between several people in real time, for a better experience it is recommended to connect bluetooth headphones to the phone, furthermore the application will continue to work also in background and with the phone on standby
WalkieTalkie translates one selected spoken source language into the other language on one phone. Choose the source language before each turn; speech is not automatically recognized as bilingual.
Complete this setup to create your local profile and accept the privacy policy. You do not need a Google Cloud account or a service-account key to continue.
